additional_info.subject: 0405064 - ID0405064-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002723] IPlanet Errorcode:6 CRM:00472000270
additional_info.body:
Hello Luca,
After intervention of today with Giuseppe Cancellieri, we found 2 issues on the charger.
The main issue was a communication cable loose on Bender BC2 and this one was the reason for the outlets go out of order.
Second issue was a not proper crimping in the terminal on the same communication line and we decided to re-do the crimping to avoid future problems.
This is a picture after doing our crimping. (Pins1and 2)
Charger is now back in operation.
Thank you for your cooperation I will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
